name: Librarians of Tomorrow
what_you_do: This is a teen internship in library careers. You get training and field trips on library, college and career skills. Then you do hands-on work. You help with programs and welcome visitors. You finish a capstone project. It is about 100 hours total.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 10-12 at a NYC high school, with a parent's signed consent, available 3 to 6 hours a week outside school.
pay_detail: Stipend (amount not stated), plus volunteer service hours.
duration: Nov 2026 to June 2027, 3-6 hours a week, 100 hours total
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application deadline was October 3, 2026. Expect the next call in fall 2027 (last-year pattern).
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application or mail a print application to the Librarians of Tomorrow Internship Program, 10 Grand Army Plaza, Brooklyn, NY 11238. Questions: LOT@bklynlibrary.org or 718-230-2406.
notes: Library teen page lists ages 15-18; the program page requires grades 10-12 in NYC. Paid work for people under 18 in New York needs working papers (employment certificate). See permit.html?state=ny for the exact permit and steps.
